🐓 This Friday, we pay tribute to Dolly Parton with The Best Little Whorehouse in Texas 🐔 

The Best Little Whorehouse in Texas is a hit 1982 musical comedy starring Dolly Parton and Burt Reynolds. Based on the 1978 Broadway musical, the film is a fictionalized account of the real-life "Chicken Ranch," a legendary and beloved brothel operating quietly outside a small Texas town.The story follows the outspoken madam, Miss Mona (Parton), who runs the ranch, and her long-time flame, the town sheriff Ed Earl Dodd (Reynolds). The town's peaceful status quo is thrown into chaos when a sensationalist television muckraker, Melvin P. Thorpe (Dom DeLuise), launches a pious public crusade to expose the ranch and shut it down. Filled with big Southern charm, comedy, and unforgettable musical numbers written by Carol Hall and Dolly Parton (including "Hard Candy Christmas"), the film remains a beloved 1980s classic.
